contexts.text: The high places of Aven () = the love of self.
(Origin of worship on high places). AC 2722.
The externals of the worship (of the Ancient Church) were high places, etc.
Celestial things, which are of love and charity, were represented by the things which were high and lofty...
Instead of mountains and hills, they made for themselves high places. Illustrated.

To ride upon the high places of the earth () = intelligence. ( = to be gifted with higher understanding. AC 6534.) ( = the intelligence of those who are of the Church, that it is interior. AE 314:7. AE 374:10.) ( = to give the understanding of higher or interior Truths concerning the things of the Church and Heaven. AE 617:14.) AE 619:9.
Where there were no hills, they constructed high places.

The sons of Israel went out with a lofty hand () = that they were taken away from the endeavour (of evil Spirits) to subjugate by Divine power... The reason lofty = what is Divine, is that by it is signified Heaven where is what is Divine. Hence it is said of Jehovah... that He dwells on high (). Illustrated.
Variegated high places () = the worship of what is false. ( = truths falsified. AE 195:7.)
High places () = idolatrous worship in general.
The Last Judgment is meant by, Jehovah... treads upon the high places of the earth (). Upon the high places of the earth = upon those who are in high places...
They who are in such love of self... are said... to ascend above the heights of the cloud ().
The lofty tower, and the fortified wall () = confirmed principles of falsity...

High places, with the Ancients, signified Heaven... whence came the rite of sacrificing upon high mountains; and, in their place, upon high places built up high; and therefore worship from the evils and falsities of doctrine is signified by, making a lofty place and a high place in every street (). AE 695:25.
Above the stars, and above the heights of the cloud = above Divine truth... The heights of the cloud = the interior truths of the Word.
